description: Two faders, each generating a manual DC voltage

params.text: Sets the voltage at the output of that channel

outputs.text: A unipolar positive DC voltage set by that channel's fader

menu: Fader 1 scale: 5V, 10V — sets the voltage the first fader reaches at the top of its travel, which the hardware sets with a jumper
Fader 2 scale: 5V, 10V — sets the voltage the second fader reaches at the top of its travel, which the hardware sets with a jumper
